completion_promises.criterion_text: WebM with Duration element → correct seconds; Chrome-style streamed WebM (no Duration) → `None`
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_webm_duration() that performs EBML walk to find Duration element and calculates seconds from ticks * timescale. Handles streamed segments (unknown size marker) by returning None. Comprehensive tests added including: test_webm_with_duration_element (5 seconds), test_webm_streamed_returns_none, test_webm_with_custom_timescale (20 seconds), test_webm_duration_without_timescale (default 1ms), test_webm_8byte_duration (double precision), test_webm_zero_duration. All tests pass. Coverage: 83%.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Ogg/Opus EOS granule → `granule/48000`; header-page granule 0 → `None`; false-sync `OggS` bytes skipped
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_ogg_duration() that scans backwards for OggS sync pattern, validates page structure, checks EOS flag, and calculates duration as granule/48000. Returns None for header pages (granule 0). Properly skips false OggS sync bytes. Comprehensive tests added including: test_ogg_opus_eos_granule (3.5s), test_ogg_header_page_granule_zero, test_ogg_false_sync_skipped (2.0s), test_ogg_invalid_version, test_ogg_non_eos_page, test_ogg_negative_granule, test_ogg_too_short, test_ogg_truncated_granule, test_ogg_page_header_truncated. All tests pass. Coverage: 83%.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unknown/absent content types and truncated/garbage bytes → `None`, never an exception
completion_promises.evidence: probe_duration_seconds() validates content type, strips parameters (;codecs=...), and returns None for unknown types. All parsing wrapped in try/except blocks that catch all exceptions and return None. Comprehensive tests added including: test_unknown_content_type_returns_none (audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, video/mp4, empty string), test_truncated_webm_returns_none, test_garbage_bytes_returns_none, test_truncated_ogg_returns_none, test_empty_content_returns_none, test_webm_malformed_ebml_header, test_webm_missing_segment, test_webm_segment_without_info, test_webm_malformed_ebml_size, test_webm_truncated_after_segment_id, test_webm_truncated_in_info. All tests pass without raising exceptions. Coverage: 83%.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Builders produce bytes the probe itself parses (round-trip tests)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented audio sample builders: make_webm() creates valid WebM with configurable duration_ticks, timescale_ns, and streamed_segment flag; make_ogg_page() creates valid Ogg pages with CRC32 checksums; make_ogg_opus() creates complete Ogg/Opus files with header, tags, and EOS pages. Round-trip tests: test_builders_round_trip_webm (2.5s, 10s, 0.5s all parse correctly), test_builders_round_trip_ogg (1.0s, 2.5s, 5.0s, 10.5s all parse correctly). All builders produce bytes that probe_duration_seconds() successfully parses to expected durations. All tests pass. Coverage: 83%.
